propositions: Dependabot PR #131 requires re-authoring as a Gerrit change because GitHub is a read-only mirror that rejects direct PR merges
Upgrading mypy and ruff may surface new linting or type-checking findings that must be fixed in source code rather than suppressed via ignores or exclusions

The complexity baseline file must remain unmodified; if newer ruff rescores unchanged functions differently, the ratchet must be shrunk by behavior-preserving code extraction, never by editing the baseline lock
The change must pass make lint, make typecheck, and the full test suite under the new tool versions with zero source modifications needed
PR #131 must be verified closed after the Gerrit change lands and the GitHub mirror syncs, confirming dependabot's auto-closure or closing it manually if needed
